name: Sishir Canyon
summary: Webs and Deepmoss spiders choke Sishir Canyon, the eastern pass through the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers face the brood on the dangerous way to the Ruins of Eldre'thar.

sections.title: The Webbed Pass
sections.body: Sishir Canyon cuts through the Stonetalon Mountains toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar. Deepmoss spiders have overrun the gorge. Sheets of web cover its stone floor and walls, and egg sacs cluster among them. Travelers and sentinels heading for the night elven ruins must fight through swarms of aggressive webspinners.

sections.title: Besseleth's Domain
sections.body: Deep in Sishir Canyon, Besseleth rules as matriarch of the Deepmoss brood. Her great size and venom threaten anyone trying to secure the pass. Local forces in Stonetalon keep watch and warn travelers that scattered spiders are not all that lurks in the webbed depths. Besseleth fiercely guards her brood.

faq.answer: Sishir Canyon winds through the Stonetalon Mountains from the main mountain paths toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar.

faq.q: What creatures live in the canyon?
faq.answer: Predatory Deepmoss spiders have claimed the canyon. They spread webs and egg sacs across the ravine and prey on creatures that enter their territory.
Besseleth is the massive, deadly matriarch of the Deepmoss brood. She dwells deep within Sishir Canyon and threatens travelers passing through.

aliases: what is at the end of sishir canyon
faq.answer: Follow Sishir Canyon east to reach the Ruins of Eldre'thar, an ancient night elven site high in the mountains.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you must fight through dense spider nests to reach the ancestral Ruins of Eldre'thar. The overrun canyon blocks safe passage, and Kaldorei sentinels and scholars face the same danger.
As a Hunter, you can test your skill tracking and trapping wild beasts in Sishir Canyon's tight ravine. Webs and venomous Deepmoss spiders make the work dangerous.
